title: DataICD
description: Data Interface Control Document checklist. Deterministic Python checks where rules are clear. Applicability (Is Applicable) is separate from conformity (Answer).

template_gap.note: No production DataICD .xlsx was found in the repo. A minimal synthetic fixture supports mapping/preservation tests only. Do not claim additional real template workbooks exist. When a real template is supplied, set excel_template_path and regenerate cell maps.
template_gap.applicability_vs_conformity: Column Is Applicable records applicability only. Answer records conformity only. Never write conformity into Is Applicable.

cell_mapping.status_policy: Never set Status=Closed solely because AI answered; only human-supplied status is written.
cell_mapping.applicability_policy: Never write conformity Answer into Is Applicable.

items.prompt: Is a Data ICD document applicable to this project baseline?
items.applicability: Always evaluated; this item records applicability itself.

subchecks.text: Pinned or primary document has ICD-like content or doc_type icd/data_icd

items.acceptance_criteria: Is Applicable reflects whether ICD review applies; Answer is NA when not applicable (conformity not written into Is Applicable).

items.prompt: Does every ICD record include a signal/parameter identifier?
items.applicability: Applies when Data ICD is applicable.

subchecks.text: Every parsed ICD record has an identifier

items.acceptance_criteria: YES only if full scan finds identifiers on all records; zero records → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (not NO).

items.prompt: Are signal/parameter identifiers unique across all ICD records?
items.applicability: Applies when Data ICD is applicable.

subchecks.text: No duplicate signal/parameter IDs across all records

items.acceptance_criteria: YES if unique; NO if duplicates; zero records → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

items.prompt: Does every ICD record specify a data type?
items.applicability: Applies when Data ICD is applicable.

subchecks.text: Every record has a non-empty data type field

items.acceptance_criteria: Full scan of all records; missing type → NO; no records → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

items.prompt: Does every ICD record specify units (or N/A for dimensionless)?
items.applicability: Applies when Data ICD is applicable.

subchecks.text: Every record has units or N/A

items.acceptance_criteria: Full scan; blank units → NO; no records → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

items.prompt: Are ICD record descriptions present for all records (manual judgment)?
items.applicability: Applies when Data ICD is applicable.
items.acceptance_criteria: Engine proposes MANUAL_REVIEW; human decision in Phase 5 path.
